To disable this feature, users must execute a specific command in the Terminal application, as it is not available in System Settings. This action turns off the light imme
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
14 与 16 英寸 MacBook Pro 的发光 Apple logo 需在 Terminal 用命令关闭

关键数字：14 / 16 · 相关方：MacBook Pro / Apple / Terminal

New 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models reintroduce the illuminated Apple logo, which automatically adjusts to ambient light. To disable this feature, users must execute a specific command in the Terminal application, as it is not available in System Settings. This action turns off the light imme

为什么值得看：开关不进系统设置而落到命令行，说明厂商把低频定制留给了可脚本化通道

对我意味着什么：对 automation 有借鉴：可脚本化的开关应配一份可回滚命令清单，本机设备配置才能进幂等流水线

下一步：把该命令纳入设备配置脚本并跑一次 dry-run，若 0 处副作用才允许在其它机器复用

ns0:entry.ns0:content:
Apple 的 OLED 触控 MacBook Pro 提供 14 与 16 英寸机型，起价分别为 $2,899 与 $3,399

关键数字：$2,899 / $3,399 / 14 / 16 · 相关方：Apple / MacBook Pro / OLED XDR / M5 Pro

Apple’s new PROLED MacBook Pro, launched in 2026, replaces the previous mini-LED model with a thinner, lighter, and more responsive design. It features an OLED XDR display with touch capabilities, including swipe, tap, and pinch-to-zoom gestures, alongside a Dynamic Island for Siri and Live Activiti

为什么值得看：原文自己下了判断：触控属增量改进而非笔记本交互的根本变化，硬件叙事需要打折读

对我意味着什么：对 WinVM 与数据基建暂无直接影响：本机形态不改变 agent 部署与 MCP 通道，仅影响本地开发设备选型

下一步：若后续出现 2 个以上独立来源确认触控提升效率，才把它列入开发机换机依据
